svg.text: THE UNDERGROUND, THE LONG TUNNEL: the labyrinth square by square, levels 116 to 103 (a proposal)
north is up · one plot = 12 x 12 squares = 42 m
to The West Tunnel (5 levels down)
cave passage (the number is its level)
- - a FOUND way up (a climb, a trunk, a ladder)
┄ level ON PURPOSE (an open place, a fight place)
▒ a STAIR (real stair pieces cut in the face; walked both ways)
Every box is one 3.5 m battle square. The number in a square is its LEVEL (1 level = 1.75 m); lighter = higher. A black triangle = a RAMP
square, pointing uphill (one level over two squares).
A WHITE BAR with a tooth = a LEDGE: you hop DOWN across it (the tooth points down) and cannot climb back. That is how the walk works today:
Plot lines by district: L = The Long Tunnel. Dashes = a new plot. Orange dots = the ways out of the room; their squares keep today's
height. A PROPOSAL: nothing is built from it until mondo says so.
